questions.question: What is the advantage of using 2D jagged array over 2D rectangular array?

options.text: Allows unlimited elements as well as rows which had '0' or are empty in nature

questions.explanation: In many applications where 2 dimensional arrays are used, not all rows need to have all the elements i.e they are sparse. Many rows have 0 elements. In such cases it is better to use 2D jagged arrays as they allow unequal number of elements in each row and also allow for empty rows.
